messages:
maya: heads-up: ~30% of eu-west-1 GPU nodes stuck in "joining" after this morning's firewall rollout. node logs show KMS decrypt failures and STS Deny. :eyes:
liam: copying logs?
maya: pasted a short snippet from node agent:
```
2026-03-21T08:12:23Z error keystore: decrypt failed status=AccessDenied action=Decrypt key=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:acct:key/abcd1111 err=AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt
caused_by: sts:AssumeRole Denied - policy boundary mismatch
```
ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-548 :rotating_light:
noa: that matches the egress tighten PR we shipped at 06:30 — default-deny on privnet endpoints + removed broad allow to keystore NLB. PR #4321 by infra.
devin: audit logs show an assume-role call failing from node role -> keystore-role with condition on `aws:SourceVpc` that doesn't match new privnet subnets.
chris-sec: we need the audit trail and who approved the PR before we touch rules. retention for this thread: keep logs 90d.
sre-oncall: short-term plan: open a temporary SG to allow node CIDR -> keystore NLB 443 for 2h; fallback route to eu-backup-keystore if that doesn't work. Who can add the SG?
noa: I can add the SG, but need approval from sec for the temporary exception. tagging @chris-sec.
chris-sec: approve temporary SG with strict expiry + annotated in the PR. Document the approver and reason in INC-2026-548. :thumbsup:
noa: running command to add rule (will expire in 2h):
```bash
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0abc1234 --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.32.0.0/22 --description "TEMP allow for keystore decrypt (INC-2026-548) expires in 2h"
```
liam: after rule applied, observed node join progress: 6/8 recovered and ready. KMS decrypt latency still showing spikes (~500-800ms) in stackdriver.
devin: fallback note: switching to eu-backup-keystore (dedicated) increases monthly baseline cost; I'll add cost estimate to the ticket.
maya: can we also enable short-term KMS client retries + jitter to smooth errors? quick patch: client retry 5 attempts with exponential backoff.
liam: pushed small client-side retry change to node-agent canary, rolling to 10% now.
chris-sec: reminder: any temporary network change requires audit annotation in the ticket + link to PR with rollback plan. I'll hold off full approval until that's added.
sre-oncall: ops summary for the ticket (INC-2026-548):
- root cause: firewall egress tightening removed required allow for keystore NLB + role boundary SourceVpc condition mismatch
- mitigation: temporary SG rule added (expires in 2h) + client retry patch rolled to canary + scale warmpool in eu-west-1 from 12->18 to absorb joins
- followups: revert PR #4321 and rework SRG to use explicit privnet CIDR mapping; audit log retention check; run postmortem w/ runbook updates.
ops-bot: scheduled postmortem meeting on 2026-03-22 14:00 UTC.
noa: removing temp rule now (2h passed) — will re-evaluate after warmpool stabilizes.
liam: final check: eu-west-1 node join rate back to baseline and keystore error rate down to <1%. Marking incident as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
chris-sec: please attach the change approval and list of approvers to INC-2026-548 before we close.
sre-oncall: noted. thanks all. :bow:
